projects.title: Task Queue
bullets: Implemented linked structures and traversal operations for a team task queue project using Python and Git.
Documented operation costs and boundary cases, and compared alternative data structures for the recorded task queue operations.

projects.title: Recipe Organiser
bullets: Implemented a menu-driven recipe organiser in Python using functions and collections, with input checks and handling for invalid entries.
Tested representative inputs for the recipe organiser and recorded the expected outputs for those inputs.
